summary: @ornikar/prismic-components ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the binary in a temp directory, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (function WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM), hex-mangled identifiers, and a '// @bun @bun-cjs' banner indicating it is compiled specifically for execution under the dropped Bun binary. The package.json has empty author, description, and license fields, no README, and the declared main entry 'index.js' is absent from the tarball — the preinstall dropper is the package's only functional content. The scoped name @ornikar/prismic-components with empty metadata is consistent with dependency-confusion targeting of the Ornikar organization. The obfuscated payload is executed under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
